$comment: generated by scripts/gen-pointer.mjs - do not hand-edit
color: currentColor - the consumer sets cream or ink; see tones

units.hostScale: A frame its host shows at scale s divides every length in divideByHostScale by s, so the dot keeps its page size. The host posts s; with no message s is 1.
units.ringStroke: The ring's stroke is non-scaling-stroke, so sizing its svg does not carry it along: set the ring circle's stroke-width to 1.5 / s yourself.

anchor: center - each svg's viewBox is centered on 0,0, the point the pointer marks
css: none shipped - the hero's click lives inside an 8s beat as percentages and the demo animates with the Web Animations API, so an absolute-time keyframe file serves neither

dot.boxNote: sized to the halo at the peak of its pop (27px), so an inline svg never clips it

halo.edgeFill: the tone at haloEdge, painted over the fill

ring.rest: opacity 0. Clone the svg per press, run ringGrow and ringFade on its circle, and remove it when they finish.
ring.stays: where the press landed. It does not ride with the dot.
ring.scale: the circle, never the svg: non-scaling-stroke holds the hairline only against a transform inside the svg

tones.override: The svg carries the default tone's weights as presentation attributes, so CSS on [data-part=halo-fill] (fill-opacity) and [data-part=halo-edge] (stroke-opacity) wins. A transition on those and on color gives the crossfade on one element.

rule.for: a consumer that picks its own tone (the demo). A host that names its tone (the hero) skips it.
rule.measure: the relative luminance of the first opaque background under the dot

pressed.tween: none - the core steps to it
pressed.holds: from the press to the release, through a drag's carry

press.note: Every press, whatever the button: a right-click and a select's pick draw as clicks, and a double-click is two presses, so two rings.

release.note: No ring. A drag's drop is a release, not a click.

fillMode: none - every part rests on its shipped attributes, so a finished animation returns to rest by itself
reducedMotion: static - draw the dot at rest; play no press, pop or ring
